# WebAction.Request

```m
WebAction.Request(method as text, url as text, optional options as nullable record) as any
```

Creates an action that, when executed, will return the results of performing an HTTP request as a binary value.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/webaction-request)
